claim.claim-text: 1. A method of printing onto a base, the method comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the first adjusted portion fills the first cavity and an upper surface of the first adjusted portion is <f>lush to an upper surface of the non-adjusted portion, the method optionally further comprising printing a second layer on the upper surface of the base layer, wherein the second layer is printed from the image file.
3. The method according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the structure is a three-dimensional object.
4. The method according to claim 1, further comprising, detecting a second depth of a second cavity on the base that is greater than the first depth of the first cavity.
5. The method according to claim 4, wherein the modified image file further includes,

a second adjusted thickness for a second portion of the layer corresponding to the second cavity; and wherein the base <l>ayer includes a second adjusted portion printed within the second cavity, wherein the second adjusted portion has the second adjusted thickness, and wherein the second adjusted portion optionally partially fills the second cavity.
6. The method according to any one of claims 1-5, wherein the base comprises a portion of an article of footwear.
7. A method of printing a three-dimensional structure onto a base comprising:
8. The method according to claim 7, further comprising detecting a third depth of the third cavity;

generating a second modified image file using the third depth, wherein the second modified image file includes a third adjusted thickness of a third portion of the layer corresponding to the third cavity; and printing a second layer directly onto the base layer using the second modified image file, wherein the second layer includes a third adjusted portion printed within the third cavity and a second non-adjusted portion printed onto the base layer, wherein the third adjusted portion has the third adjusted thickness and the second non-adjusted portion has the predetermined thickness.

9. The method according to claim 8, wherein the third adjusted portion fills the third cavity and an upper surface of the third adjusted portion is continuous with an upper surface of the second non-adjusted portion, and

wherein the method optionally further comprises printing a third layer directly onto the upper surface of the second layer using the image file, wherein the third layer has a thickness that is constant and equal to the predetermined thickness.
10. The method according to any of claims 7-9, wherein the sensing device is a digital image sensor.
11. A system of printing onto a base comprising:
the printing device configured to:

receive the adjusted image file; and print a base layer directly onto the base using the adjusted image file, wherein the base layer includes an adjusted portion having the adjusted thickness and a non-adjusted portion having the predetermined thickness.

12. The system according to claim 11, wherein the image file is a grayscale file of the structure, and wherein the adjusted portion optionally fills the cavity and an upper surface of the adjusted portion is optionally on a same plane as an upper surface of the non-adjusted portion.

13. The system according to claim 11 or 12, wherein the printing device is further configured to print another layer onto an upper surface of the base layer using the image file having the predetermined thickness.
14. The system according to any one of claims 11-13, wherein the structure is a three-dimensional object.
15. The system according to any one of claims 11-14, wherein the control system further comprises a sensing device to detect information about the depth of the cavity.
